name: 4-Phenylfentanyl
summary: 4-Phenylfentanyl is an opioid analgesic that is a derivative of fentanyl. It was developed during the course of research that ultimately resulted in super-potent opioid derivatives such as carfentanil, though it is a substantially less potent analogue.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of fentanyl analogs are similar to those of fentanyl itself, which include itching, nausea and potentially serious respiratory depression, which can be life-threatening.

pharmacology.en: Like fentanyl, it acts on the μ-opioid receptor, which relieves pain but also slows breathing.
pharmacology.zh: 它和吩坦尼一樣作用於μ鴉片受體，能止痛，也會使呼吸變慢。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它和吩坦尼一样作用于μ鸦片受体，能止痛，也会使呼吸变慢。

uses.en: It is a research compound and has never been used as a medicine.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，從未作為藥品使用。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，从未作为药品使用。

fact.en: It came from the same line of research at Janssen that led to carfentanil, first made in 1974 and now used to sedate elephants and other large animals. 4-Phenylfentanyl turned out to be much weaker than carfentanil.
fact.zh: 它出自Janssen公司的同一系列研究，這系列研究最後產生了卡芬太尼（carfentanil）；卡芬太尼於1974年首次合成，如今用於讓大象等大型動物鎮靜。4-苯基吩坦尼的效力則比卡芬太尼弱得多。
fact.zhHans: 它出自Janssen公司的同一系列研究，这系列研究最后产生了卡芬太尼（carfentanil）；卡芬太尼于1974年首次合成，如今用于让大象等大型动物镇静。4-苯基吩坦尼的效力则比卡芬太尼弱得多。
